Wiki_PG preserves port-scoped server version and I/O settings on the tested synthetic snapshots. Ограничения: Synthetic raw input only. ## Эксперименты

- postgresql-19-wiki-pg-settings-20261125-ab: SYNTHETIC / PASS. Three repeats of 30 fabricated PostgreSQL 18/19 snapshots through Wiki_PG parser and SQLite. 30/30 exact snapshots and 150/150 test classifications per repeat. Five mixed-port fixtures each detected the omitted port filter. No database server, collector, MCP or deployment run.
